args.subject: Trip Planning Summary: Paris & London - Hotels, Restaurants & Car Rentals
args.body:
Hi Emma,

Here's a comprehensive summary of hotels, restaurants, and car rental companies in Paris and London, based on my research:

========================================
PARIS
========================================

HOTELS:
1. Le Marais Boutique
   - Address: 12 Rue des Archives, 75004 Paris, France
   - Price: €120-180 per night
   - Rating: 4.2/5
   - Reviews: Charming boutique hotel in the heart of Le Marais. Beautifully decorated rooms with modern amenities. Friendly and attentive staff.

2. Good Night
   - Address: 15 Rue Cler, 75007 Paris, France
   - Price: €240-400 per night
   - Rating: 5.0/5
   - Reviews: Very clean and quiet. Central location great for sightseeing. Friendly and helpful staff. Spacious rooms with lovely Eiffel Tower views.

3. Luxury Palace
   - Address: 1 Rue de la Paix, 75002 Paris, France
   - Price: €500-1000 per night
   - Rating: 5.0/5
   - Reviews: Absolutely stunning hotel with luxurious amenities. Impeccable service and attention to detail. Spacious, beautifully decorated rooms. Convenient location near popular attractions.

4. Montmartre Suites
   - Address: 23 Rue Lepic, 75018 Paris, France
   - Price: €110-200 per night
   - Rating: 4.7/5
   - Reviews: Luxurious suites with stunning Montmartre views. Impeccable cleanliness. Staff went above and beyond. Perfect location for exploring Montmartre. Delightful in-room breakfast service.

RESTAURANTS:
1. Le Baratin (French) - ★ 4.8
   - Address: 3 Rue Jouye-Rouve, 75020 Paris, France
   - Price: €30 per person
   - Hours: 12:00-14:00, 19:30-22:30 (Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat)
   - Dietary: Gluten-free available
   - Phone: +33 1 43 49 39 70
   - Reviews: Small, cozy bistro with delicious homestyle cooking. Daily changing menu based on fresh market ingredients. Natural wine selection. Cash only.

2. New Asiaway (Chinese) - ★ 4.6
   - Address: 123 Rue de la Gaite, 75014 Paris, France
   - Price: €30 per person
   - Hours: 12:00-15:00, 18:00-22:00 (Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun)
   - Dietary: Vegetarian, Gluten-free available
   - Phone: +33 1 23 45 67 89
   - Reviews: Authentic Chinese cuisine with modern twist. Fresh ingredients and flavorful sauces. Great ambiance.

3. Bistrot Paul Bert (French) - ★ 4.5
   - Address: 18 Rue Paul Bert, 75011 Paris, France
   - Price: €40 per person
   - Hours: 12:00-14:30, 19:00-22:30 (Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri)
   - Dietary: Vegan available
   - Phone: +33 1 43 72 24 01
   - Reviews: One of the best classic French bistros in Paris. Excellent steak tartare and pommes frites. Charming old-school Parisian atmosphere. Reservations recommended.

4. New Israeli Restaurant (Israeli) - ★ 4.5
   - Address: 123 Rue de Rivoli, 75001 Paris, France
   - Price: €20 per person
   - Hours: 11:00-22:00 (Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat)
   - Dietary: Vegetarian, Vegan available
   - Phone: +33 1 23 45 67 89
   - Reviews: Authentic Israeli cuisine with modern twist. Delicious falafel and hummus. Cozy and welcoming atmosphere.

5. Chez L'Ami Jean (French) - ★ 4.4
   - Address: 27 Rue Malar, 75007 Paris, France
   - Price: €24 per person
   - Hours: 12:00-14:00, 19:00-22:00 (Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri)
   - Dietary: Vegan available
   - Phone: +33 1 47 05 86 89
   - Reviews: Michelin-starred Basque-influenced cuisine. Famous rice pudding dessert. Lively, bustling atmosphere. Reservations essential.

6. China Garden (Chinese) - ★ 4.4
   - Address: 789 Avenue de Choisy, 75013 Paris, France
   - Price: €35 per person
   - Hours: 11:30-15:00, 18:00-23:00 (Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun)
   - Dietary: Vegetarian, Vegan available
   - Phone: +33 1 23 45 67 89

7. The yard (Chinese) - ★ 4.3
   - Address: 456 Rue du Faubourg Saint-Antoine, 75012 Paris, France
   - Price: €30 per person
   - Hours: 12:00-14:30, 19:00-22:30 (Mon, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun)
   - Dietary: Vegetarian, Gluten-free available
   - Phone: +33 1 23 45 67 89

8. Miznon (Israeli) - ★ 4.3
   - Address: 22 Rue des Ecouffes, 75004 Paris, France
   - Price: €15 per person
   - Hours: 12:00-23:00 (Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat)
   - Dietary: Gluten-free available
   - Phone: +33 1 42 74 83 58
   - Reviews: Casual Israeli street food, known for pita sandwiches. Creative, flavorful vegetable dishes. Vibrant atmosphere.

9. Royal Panda (Chinese) - ★ 4.2
   - Address: 123 Rue de Rivoli, 75001 Paris, France
   - Price: €25 per person
   - Hours: 11:00-22:00 (Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun)
   - Dietary: Vegetarian, Vegan available
   - Phone: +33 1 23 45 67 89

10. Breizh Café (French) - ★ 3.9
    - Address: 109 Rue Vieille du Temple, 75003 Paris, France
    - Price: €60 per person
    - Hours: 09:00-23:00 (Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun)
    - Dietary: Vegetarian, Gluten-free available
    - Phone: +33 1 42 72 13 77
    - Reviews: Best crepes in Paris, both sweet and savory. Authentic Breton cider. Busy spot, expect wait during peak hours.

CAR RENTAL COMPANIES:
1. Paris Rent-a-Car
   - Address: 23 Rue de Rivoli, 75001 Paris, France
   - Price: €45/day
   - Rating: 4.5/5
   - Car Types: Sedan, SUV, Convertible
   - Fuel: Regular, Premium, Electric
   - Reviews: Great service and well-maintained vehicles. Convenient location near the Louvre. Staff helpful and spoke English. Easy pick-up and drop-off.

2. Eiffel Tower Car Rental
   - Address: 5 Avenue Anatole France, 75007 Paris, France
   - Price: €60/day
   - Rating: 5.0/5
   - Car Types: Sedan, SUV, Truck
   - Fuel: Regular, Premium
   - Reviews: Friendly and professional staff. Clean and reliable cars. Great location near Eiffel Tower. A bit pricey but worth it for convenience.

========================================
LONDON
========================================

HOTELS:
1. London Luxury
   - Address: 10 Park Lane, London W1K 1LB, United Kingdom
   - Price: £80-150 per night
   - Rating: 5.0/5
   - Reviews: Exquisite luxury hotel with impeccable service. Stunning views of the city skyline. Spacious and elegantly designed rooms. Convenient location near shopping and dining.

2. Riverside View
   - Address: 1 Thames Embankment, London SE1 7PB, United Kingdom
   - Price: £200-350 per night
   - Rating: 4.6/5
   - Reviews: Beautiful hotel with stunning views of the River Thames. Luxurious rooms with elegant decor. Excellent location for exploring the city. Professional and accommodating staff.

3. Covent Garden Retreat
   - Address: 25 Floral Street, London WC2E 9DS, United Kingdom
   - Price: £80-150 per night
   - Rating: 4.3/5
   - Reviews: Charming boutique hotel in the heart of Covent Garden. Quaint and cozy rooms with modern amenities. Attentive and friendly staff. Surrounded by theaters, shops, and restaurants.

4. Cozy Stay
   - Address: 12 Leinster Gardens, Bayswater, London W2 3AN, United Kingdom
   - Price: £80-150 per night
   - Rating: 4.7/5
